details:
Hello, i am heavy into world/avatar optimizations(over 9 years experience).

i was originally at 722-754 FPS, and decided to do a lot of hidden world optimizations,

that lead to me being up to an avg 884(high 905)

Then, i decided to code my own shader.

After doing a lot of optimizations and such last night i was up to 940-971 fps.

decided to work on my shader again, and logged into my map "kami's lookout" after today's update.

And bam, i am back to 676-755(avg 722)

and i didnt even do anything different.

It was right after today's update 11.24.2026(my birthday by the way)

i will show screenshots from lastnight and the other days i was testing my map.

Vs today.

i tried deleting the cache and everything ingame.

using pcmanager on my pc to clear its cache.... nope...still stuck, the only thing i seen the highest FPS for a moment was 791.

my pc specs:

MotherBoard: Asrock X870E Nova

Ram: G.SKILL Trident Z5 Royal Neo Series DDR5 RAM 32GB 8000hz CL36-48-48-128 1.45V

OS: Windows 11 Pro 25H2 - FSOS V11

GPU: NVidia ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 4090 OC Edition 24GB GDDR6X

CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D

Liquid cooler: ARCTIC Liquid Freezer III 420

monitor: MPG "321URX QD-OLED" and "LG 27GN950-B"

VR headset: Pimax 5K super.
title: Lost 200FPS after VRchat update.
